ownerEvidence.quote:
# H1 owner-request record

2026-10-04. This is an owner-supplied hybrid preview. Production font, artwork and implementation acceptance remain pending.

The exact owner quote, supplied by the coordinating root agent, is:

> I kind of feel the font is the only issue. Can you try higher-quality images? And make the strip completely full at the bottom. And apart from that can you mix the directions of first and second?

“First” means q1 Compact directory; “second” means q2 Editorial split. The requested hybrid is a preview, not final new-art/font acceptance or Fleet production acceptance.

Combine q1's compact, grouped product routes on the left with q2's AI-first editable question, five icon-only assistant handoffs, and always-open product updates form on the right. Keep all native links and disclosures, visible question/email labels, required unchecked consent, accessible44px assistant controls, exact existing dynamic handoff/no-send behavior, and no repeated prompt chips.

Use actual project-native system sans in the middle: restrained16–18px primary links,14px secondary routes, consistent12px labels/consent and16px fields. PH declares Inter but has no local font asset; this preview uses its honest system-ui fallback and does not claim Inter was loaded. CodeVetter uses the native SF/system fallback and600 service headings. Preserve the large Atlas serif/Code native signature, smooth fade and central scene clearance.

The studio row is the literal last visible/DOM region, full-bleed and distributed to both ends: From the studio · HeyPace · PostTrainLLM · GitStat · All projects ↗. Use the real canonical destinations and names only. Narrow layouts keep readable one-line local scrolling and44px links rather than squeezing text.

Initial UI source reused exact unchanged2172×724 v2 masters and is preserved at h1/initial-v2-source with SHA records. Its provisional browser run was cancelled before child launch once root's accepted finer-detail assets were available. The integrated source now uses exact v3 WebP siblings from artwork/v3-manifest.json with actual2172×724 dimensions and source/decoded equality evidence. These are finer-detail imagegen edits at the same native resolution; no fabricated4K, producer upscaling, sharpening, recoloring or raster editing. CSS, typography and interaction JS remain unchanged from the initial hybrid source. B owns the actual integrated renders and distinct scan checkpoints; source is frozen for that pass. Prior rounds and production remain untouched.

contract.qualityBar: Restrained native sans typography, personalized detailed artwork, distributed full-width bottom strip, accessible icon-only assistants and always-visible email field.
